name: Shelly Linestad
original_name: シェリー=ラインスタッド
source:
She is the girl with whom Towa first met when he got lost in this world, caring Towa in various ways.
As the daughter of the Linestad family that inherit hero's blood, she received sword training from her father when she lived in the mansion deep in the forest of the royal capital, Salem.
Due to her father's missing, she is currently working at a cafe so as to pay off the debt.
Although she doesn't know much about the world and clumsy, she always holds a positive attitude towards everything with all her might.
Not doubting other people, she encounters dangers from time to time.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
